title: THE PEOPLE HAVE SPOKEN!! #2819church #philipanthonymitchell #atlanta #israelites #christian #bible
segments: I did something a little different this
Sabbath. I went to NIUC camp. I went to
the one in Atlanta, which is about an
hour drive from where I live and an hour
and 15 minute drive with traffic. I'm
going to try to tie this all up in one
video, but I did not have a bad
experience. I mean, don't beat me up for
this, but my original plan when I was
going there, the plan that I repeated to
myself over and over during that drive
was to speak when spoken to and sit down
last so I don't sit in anybody's seat
and don't drink any water so I don't
have to ask anybody where the bathroom
is because I was extremely nervous. That
was my plan, but that plan died very
quickly. There was this one lady there.
She was very nice and she made sure I
had everything I needed and I really
appreciated her for that because
honestly I really couldn't even believe
I was there. I had no idea what I was
doing there. Honestly, I don't see why
people are calling them a cult because I
did not get cult vibes when I was there.
Um the only vibes I really got was
people reading the Bible.
That was it. The women, they did not
seem oppressed. They seemed very happy.
I was really going to leave after that
second class before like that 6:00
class, but um my mental health was
pretty good, so I wasn't having like a
nervous anxiety attack or anything, so I
figured let me just stay and just get
the experience. Being there
as opposed to just watching it on TV is
definitely different in a good way. And
you know, like I said before, my
experience wasn't bad. Um, I would love
to go back and see it through. And yeah.
